shared_elements: monolithic upright pillar bearing carved relief decoration
animal figure in relief on the pillar shaft
band of parallel incised lines across the shaft (hand/fingers or hatched band)
animal head shown in profile with rounded muzzle
elements arranged in stacked horizontal zones down the shaft
justification: Both surfaces are upright shafts carved with animal figures and a band of parallel incised strokes running across the shaft (in A a hatched band above the animal register, in B the fingers of a relief arm/hand), and both stack their motifs in horizontal zones down the face, which is a moderately specific shared scheme for decorating a standing pillar. The biggest difference is that A packs multiple registers of varied profile creatures \u2014 quadrupeds, canid, snake, birds \u2014 into flat low relief, whereas B shows a single high-relief animal head projecting from the surface beside a plain limb-like element, with no register of assorted animals.
